★ Request
Fade to black

■ Stage Direction
Age: 1st year high school
Personality: Cheerful girl

★ Request
Fade to black / Fade in / Wipe
Remove Tamamo

★ Request
Fade to black
I shouted with all my might toward Super Creek as she ran the course.
That Creek wasn't feelin' too hot, that is...

I thought I just couldn't manage the training intensity properly
because I was a rookie, but to think her condition was actually off...
So please, let yourself be pampered all you want, Trainer♪
Tama-chan, thank you so much for coming all this way to cheer me on~
Whoa, hey! Stop tryin' to pat my head every chance ya get!
Her condition was off...?!

Good morning, rookie trainer, Super Creek.
It looks like you've managed some decent training, at least.
My goodness~ Look at how dependable you've become before I even noticed♪
Nice to meet you, looking forward to today.

The day of the race between Super Creek
and the veteran trainer's Umamusume—

I'll debut, rack up victories, win big races...
and make you into a truly magnificent Trainer.

I might still be a rookie,
and you'll probably end up pampering me most of the time, but...!

Oh dear, in that case, I simply have to soothe your nerves.
There, there, Trainer, you're a brave, strong kiddo~
That may be so, but I just couldn't help but wonder~

Even if ya got it mixed up, the fact that you were
watchin' Creek so closely don't change, right?

Now that we've exchanged greetings with our opponents,
I'll be on my way, Trainer.

They haven't even run half the distance yet,
and she's launching into a spurt already?!

Nah, that ain't it. That's just how Creek runs.
She's already got what it takes to debut anytime.
Oozing nothing but pure confidence in their victory, the pair walked off.

For two or three days after ya became her Trainer, she wasn't at her best.
Bet she kept quiet 'cause she didn't wanna make ya worry.
Yes, I'll do my best~.

Still, the reason she hadn't debuted until now
is 'cause her Trainer was lookin' out for her properly.

Even so... I won't let all the training I did
with Trainer and Tama-chan go to waste!

*Huff*... *huff*... *huff*... *huff*...
You're as fast as I expected~.

I gave you proper, thorough training.
You'd better show me the results out there!
She's running just as well as she did in the debut race—no, even better...

I-I see you two are on good terms, but that ends today.
I'll already have Super Creek's training regimen prepared and waiting.

You seem quite relaxed,
so I take it you've accepted the transfer.

The debut is finally approaching, isn't it?
I'm already getting nervous~.
I want to pamper my Trainer too, so I'll do my absolute best!!
Some time later—

And then, the race between Super Creek and the veteran Trainer's
Umamusume finally began.
*Haah*... *haah*... *haah*... *haah*...!
The race with the transfer on the line concluded with Super Creek's overwhelming victory.
Wait, ya didn't even know that?!

This isn't an official race, but
I'll be sure to gift you our very first win~.
Yes, I'll give it my all♪

I'm doing just fine.
Trainer encouraged me, saying that I could win.

...Still, ya made proper adjustments to her training, right?
She was so happy, sayin' "My Trainer's growin' every day."

Even though it was only the first half of the race,
Super Creek kept steadily accelerating.
Oh my~, Trainer, you really are something♪

How are you feeling, Trainer?
Are you nervous?
